I replied to Tobias in his DM: I couldn't find a standing call with Tansleigh Packaging in anything he has access to.

- **Calendar:** nothing recurring for Tansleigh shows up on the calendar I can see.
- **Channels:** I checked #central-team, #central-random, #general and #inc-tansley-carrier-api. That last one is about Tansley Parcel, Pree's account, not his packaging account. The only Tansleigh item is a July 2025 thread in #central-team about ticket #88412, the Door 6 scanner freezing.
- **Files:** a January 2026 Central digest says Hollis moved the Tuesday standup by 30 minutes because it clashed with something on Tobias's account. It doesn't give that call's time.

I told him his own calendar invite or Hollis are the best places to check. I only read channels he's a member of and public files, and didn't use message search, so nothing he couldn't see himself went into the answer.
